Method of Attack: Deploys an agent on compromised devices that connects to a Google Sheets URL to receive commands
Commands cause agents to download and install additional payloads from Google Drive or exfiltrate stolen data to cloud storage
Impacted Systems: Compromised devices of Taiwanese media company
Compromised devices of Italian job search website
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with links to password protected files hosted in Google Drive
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails containing links to password protected files in Google Drive
Use of Google Sheets URL for command and control
